findings.claim: The duplicate-version-heading warning is only emitted in --check mode; --json and --release-notes silently return the first-wins entry with no signal that the changelog has a duplicate heading for that version.
findings.fix: Emit the same duplicate-heading warning (or at least write it to stderr) for --json and --release-notes too, since the module's own doc comment says it is meant to be reused by the release workflow (Step 9) where a silently-picked wrong entry would ship in a GitHub Release.
